config.record_grain: One row per charity registered with the ACNC, with current Charity Register attributes.

fields.evidence: ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶6–7: ABN is the charity's Australian Business Number and is numeric; header/sample ABN=51214424410.
ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶8: formal name on legal/official documents, but alternate identifier may replace a withheld legal name; exact header Charity_Legal_Name.
ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶12–14: charity business street address uses Address line 1–3; exact headers Address_Line_1, Address_Line_2, Address_Line_3.
ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶13–14 lists Town/City as a business-address field; sample Town_City=Enfield.
ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶13–14 lists State as a business-address field; samples use SA, VIC, NSW, NT, QLD, WA.
ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶13–14 lists Postcode as a business-address field; sample Postcode=0820 demonstrates string preservation is required.
ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶13–14 lists Country as a business-address field; sample Country=Australia.
ACNC user notes Dec 2024, p.2, ¶15: field contains the charity website address where supplied; samples include https://www.u3ainnernorth.org.au/ and www.spectrum3.org.au.

unmapped_fields.reason: Notes p.2 ¶10–11 say this can contain one or more trading or other names, but provide no delimiter or one-name-per-value rule; do not emit an unsplit multi-name value as a single trading name.

Supplied documentation defines the address as a business address (p.2 ¶12) but does not define this additional header or its possible values; address role is set from documented dataset-level meaning.

limitations: The source is a weekly updated subset of the ACNC Charity Register and includes only charities registered with ACNC (user notes Dec 2024, p.1 ¶2–5); it is not a general company register.
Withheld information, including an entire charity record, is excluded; blank values can mean not supplied or withheld (user notes pp.1–2).
Charity_Legal_Name can be an alternate identifier when legal name is withheld (p.2 ¶8); subject_label_field preserves the raw label and the legal-name mapping is therefore provisional.
No ACN is supplied or inferred from ABN. No entity type, company status, or company registration date is asserted.
All source-reliability and field-confidence values are provisional human-review judgements.
